name: Inspection report
author: Rafael M. A. Leão Ereno - MALE
description: Generates a periodic health/inspection report of Zabbix 7.0 components (server, proxy and database). Compares dozens of metrics - caches, internal processes, NVPS, queue and OS resources - against reference thresholds and highlights issues with suggested actions. Detects and adapts to containerized (Docker) deployments, reading configuration from ZBX_* environment variables.
